definitions.mesh_closed: The STL is read as float32 and the vertices that are equal are joined. A face with two equal corners is left out (it has no area). Closed: every edge joins exactly 2 faces, the winding agrees across each edge, the volume is positive, and no closed shell is inside out (a closed shell with a negative volume that lies in no other shell).
definitions.bodies: A body is a shell of faces joined along edges that have exactly 2 faces, with an area above 1e-12 mm2. A closed shell that has a negative volume and lies inside a closed shell with a positive volume is a void (the wall of a cavity), not a body. A closed shell with a negative volume that lies in no other shell is a body that is written inside out: it counts as a body and mesh_closed fails. A body inside a void counts as a body.
definitions.closed_voids: A closed shell with a negative volume that lies inside a closed shell with a positive volume: a cavity inside the part with no opening. The volume is the volume of the cavity. A cavity that only touches the outside along an edge is not closed (the mesh is not manifold there). A cavity that two bodies enclose together is not found.
definitions.bed_fit: V2 bed fit in the build frame, with a turn about the build axis (CONTRACTS.md section 18).
definitions.overhang: V2: area of faces with n.b < -cos(angle), plate contact excluded (CONTRACTS.md section 18).
definitions.support_volume: estimate of the space under the overhang faces: sum over the faces of (free gap down to the plate or to the part) x (projected face area), in mm3; a solid-column upper bound, real supports use less material; for up to 30000 faces (random sample, fixed seed) scaled to the full overhang area
definitions.plate_contact: V2: area of faces that rest on the plate (CONTRACTS.md section 18).
definitions.wall_thickness: V2 chord estimate: 60,000 surface points, a chord along the inward face normal to the first wall. The share of the surface area with a chord under min_wall_mm - 0.0001 mm is compared with min_wall_area_pct. The rule of this check: a pass needs min_wall_mm to be at least 3 x the resolution (the voxel size of the run, or the median mesh edge, or the option); see pitfalls/mesh-coarser-than-members. The share has a sampling error of about sqrt(f (1 - f) / samples), given in the value.

note: Geometry only: no solve. A print pass is not a structural pass: the stress and the safety factor are separate checks. The thickness and the support volume are estimates. Nothing here stops a run.
